items: ONDO STATE (PSI 9.1): Ondo Audits Public Service Vacancies; Orders Leave Bonus Payment & ₦500M Loan Seed Fund
BAYELSA STATE (PSI 8.9): Obasanjo, Gov Diri Flag Off CDU at $1B Azikel Refinery; Launch Free Quarterly Health Checks
KATSINA STATE (PSI 8.8): Gov Radda Raises Bursary by 100%, Flags Off 38km Road & Praises Kurfi Youth Empowerment
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.7): Gov Sanwo-Olu Tasks ICSAN on AI Governance; LAWMA Expands Bins & Tourism Trains 57 LGAs
EDO STATE (PSI 8.6): Gov Okpebholo Issues Zero-Tolerance Cultism Warning; Plans ₦250B GRA Infrastructure Project
KWARA STATE (PSI 8.5): Gov AbdulRazaq Donates 25 Toyota Hilux Vehicles to Police Command to Boost Operations
EBONYI STATE (PSI 8.4): Gov Nwifuru Advances 39km Road Dualization & Constructs 17 Resettlement Housing Units
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.3): Adamawa Sets Oct 19 Deadline for Yola Market Relocation; ANAN Focuses on Climate Reporting
KEBBI STATE (PSI 8.2): Gov Idris Attends Argungu Empowerment Programme; Charges Appointees on Public Service
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 8.1): Zamfara Information & Budget Ministries Partner with UNICEF on Social & Behaviour Change
DELTA STATE (PSI 8.0): Gov Oborevwori Addresses 2026/2027 Legal Year Thanksgiving; Reaffirms Judicial Support
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.9): Ashaka Cement & Maiganga Community Sign 5-Year Development Agreement in Gombe
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 7.8): Gov Sule Receives SEC Board; Securities Commission Prepares to Open Lafia Office
IMO STATE (PSI 7.7): Commerce Commissioner Successfully Undergoes Surgery at State-Owned Imo Robotic Centre

ONDO (PSI 9.1): Gov Aiyedatiwa ordered collation of MDA vacancies for recruitment adding ₦800M monthly, directed immediate payment of 2026 leave bonus to state/LG workers, and boosted loan seed funds by ₦500M.

BAYELSA (PSI 8.9): Former Pres. Obasanjo and Gov Diri flagged off $1B Azikel Refinery CDU producing 2.5m L petrol daily; Gov Diri ordered free quarterly health checks across all secondary facilities in 8 LGAs.
KATSINA (PSI 8.8): Gov Radda raised bursary by 100% (disbursing ₦689M to 19k students), flagged off 38km Bindawa-Duwan road reconstruction, and praised 1,927 youth empowerment in Kurfi LGA.

LAGOS (PSI 8.7): Gov Sanwo-Olu urged ICSAN to regulate AI while revealing ₦1.87T 2025 IGR; LAWMA distributed 172 recycling bins in Osborne Estate; Tourism Ministry trained officers across 57 LGAs/LCDAs.
EDO (PSI 8.6): Gov Okpebholo warned cultists during voluntary renunciation in Benin, announced ₦250B GRA flood control proposal, and confirmed SEC approval for 33 new vehicles for state judges.
KWARA (PSI 8.5): Gov AbdulRazaq presented 25 new Toyota Hilux vehicles to Kwara Police Command as first tranche of 100 security vehicles to cover hard-to-reach areas across the state.
EBONYI (PSI 8.4): Gov Nwifuru advanced dualization of 39km Hilltop-Opherekpe road and constructed 16 bungalows and 1 duplex to resettle residents displaced by new ICT University in Opherekpe Agbaja.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.3): Commerce Ministry set Oct 19 deadline for traders to move to New Modibbo Adama Market; Dep Gov Farauta received ANAN advocating climate adaptation education.
KEBBI (PSI 8.2): Gov Idris attended Gulma empowerment programme delivering motorcycles, sewing machines, solar systems, and ambulance, charging political appointees to serve grassroots.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.1): Information and Budget Ministries met with UNICEF to align SBC work plans for infant health, education, WASH, and radio broadcasts via Kyakkyawar Safiya.
DELTA (PSI 8.0): Gov Oborevwori attended Legal Year Thanksgiving Mass in Asaba, commending judicial officers and pledging sustained executive infrastructure support for justice delivery.
GOMBE (PSI 7.9): Ministry of Energy supervised signing of 5-year CDA between Ashaka Cement and Maiganga host community to guarantee social responsibility and peaceful mining.
NASARAWA (PSI 7.8): Gov Sule received SEC Board Chairman Katuka; SEC announced finalized plans to open a branch office in Lafia and conduct state-wide investor dividend sensitization.
IMO (PSI 7.7): Trade Commissioner High Chief Rex Anunobi successfully underwent prostate surgery at state-owned Imo Robotic Centre, praising Gov Uzodimma's health technology investments.
